value.zh-CN: 当前时间，配合 bind:value 使用；type 为 timeRange 时为数组。传 null 是受控的空值，undefined 视为非受控。
value.en-US: Current time, used with bind:value; an array when type is timeRange. null is a controlled empty value, and undefined means uncontrolled.

open.zh-CN: 面板是否打开，配合 bind:open 使用；undefined 视为非受控。
open.en-US: Whether the panel is open, used with bind:open; undefined means uncontrolled.

type.zh-CN: 选择类型，time 为单个时间，timeRange 为时间范围。
type.en-US: Selection type: time for a single time, timeRange for a range.

format.zh-CN: 展示的时间格式，遵循 date-fns 的 format；use12Hours 时默认为 a h:mm:ss，否则为 HH:mm:ss。
format.en-US: Display format, following date-fns format. Defaults to a h:mm:ss with use12Hours, else HH:mm:ss.

hourStep.zh-CN: 小时选项的间隔，必须是正整数。
hourStep.en-US: Interval of the hour options; a positive integer.

minuteStep.zh-CN: 分钟选项的间隔，必须是正整数。
minuteStep.en-US: Interval of the minute options; a positive integer.

secondStep.zh-CN: 秒选项的间隔，必须是正整数。
secondStep.en-US: Interval of the second options; a positive integer.

disabledHours.en-US: Returns the hours that cannot be selected.

disabledMinutes.zh-CN: 按所选小时返回禁止选择的分钟。
disabledMinutes.en-US: Returns the minutes that cannot be selected for the selected hour.

disabledSeconds.zh-CN: 按所选小时和分钟返回禁止选择的秒。
disabledSeconds.en-US: Returns the seconds that cannot be selected for the selected hour and minute.

disabledTime.zh-CN: 仅范围模式生效：按当前值与面板位置返回左右面板各自的禁用规则。value 中未选的一侧为 undefined；返回的 disabledHours、disabledMinutes、disabledSeconds 覆盖对应的同名属性，未返回的回退到同名属性。
disabledTime.en-US: Range mode only: returns the disabled rules of the left and right panel from the current value and the panel. The unpicked side of value is undefined; a returned disabledHours, disabledMinutes or disabledSeconds overrides the prop of the same name, and one left out falls back to it.

hideDisabledOptions.en-US: Hides the options that cannot be selected.

placeholder.zh-CN: 没有值时显示的提示，默认按 type 取语言包文案。
placeholder.en-US: Hint shown without a value; defaults to the locale text of type.

rangeSeparator.en-US: Separator between the two times of a range.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

inputReadOnly.zh-CN: 输入框只读，避免在移动设备上打开虚拟键盘。
inputReadOnly.en-US: Makes the input read-only, which avoids opening the virtual keyboard on mobile devices.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 的 id，用于 aria-labelledby 关联。
insetLabelId.en-US: id of the insetLabel, referenced through aria-labelledby.

inputStyle.en-US: Style of the input's root element.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载时让输入框获得焦点，同时打开面板。
autofocus.en-US: Focuses the input on mount, which opens the panel.

focusOnOpen.zh-CN: 挂载后让输入框获得焦点并选中内容，同时打开面板。
focusOnOpen.en-US: Focuses the input and selects its content once mounted, which opens the panel.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 指示浏览器是否应滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的 focus 方法。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should scroll the document to show the newly focused element; applies to the focus call inside the component.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 浮层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether to flip the popup automatically when it is clipped.

position.zh-CN: 浮层位置，type 为 timeRange 时默认为 bottom，为 time 时默认为 bottomLeft。
position.en-US: Popup position. Defaults to bottom when type is timeRange, and bottomLeft when it is time.

popupStyle.en-US: Style of the popup, as a string.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether to stop click events on the popup from bubbling.

timeZone.zh-CN: 时区，未设置时依次取 ConfigProvider 的 timeZone、全局默认值。
timeZone.en-US: Time zone; falls back to the timeZone of ConfigProvider, then to the global default.

scrollItemProps.zh-CN: 传给各列的属性，只支持 cycled、mode、motion、transform，含义同 ScrollList 的 ScrollItem。
scrollItemProps.en-US: Props passed to the columns; only cycled, mode, motion and transform, as on the ScrollItem of ScrollList.

onChange.zh-CN: 时间变化时触发，参数为 (Date 值, 格式化字符串)，范围模式下两者都是数组；清除后单选为 undefined，范围为空数组，范围中未选的一侧为 undefined。
onChange.en-US: Called when the time changes, with (Date value, formatted string); both are arrays in range mode. Cleared, it is undefined (single) or an empty array (range); the unpicked side of a range is undefined.

onOpenChange.zh-CN: 面板打开或关闭时触发。
onOpenChange.en-US: Called when the panel opens or closes.

onFocus.zh-CN: 输入框根元素获得焦点时触发；焦点在输入框与清除按钮之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the input's root element gains focus; moving focus between the input and the clear button does not call it.

onBlur.zh-CN: 点击外部关闭面板时触发，参数为该次 mousedown 的原生事件；离开输入框不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when a click outside closes the panel, with the native event of that mousedown; leaving the input does not call it.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 输入框上的 keydown 回调。

onKeyUp.zh-CN: 输入框上的 keyup 回调。

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 输入框上按下 Enter 的回调。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called when Enter is pressed in the input.

trigger.zh-CN: 自定义触发器的 snippet，替代默认的输入框，点击其中任意位置打开面板。参数含 value（未选的一侧为 undefined）、inputValue、placeholder、disabled、componentProps 与 onChange（更新输入框文本，效果同键入）。
trigger.en-US: Snippet of a custom trigger that replaces the default input; a click anywhere in it opens the panel. Receives value (the unpicked side undefined), inputValue, placeholder, disabled, componentProps and onChange (updates the input text, as typing would).

panelHeader.zh-CN: 面板头部内容的 snippet，参数 index 为面板序号（单选为 0，范围为 0 或 1）。范围模式下未提供时显示语言包的「开始时间」「结束时间」。
panelHeader.en-US: Snippet for the content above the panel; index is the panel's position (0 for time, 0 or 1 for timeRange). Without it, a range shows the locale's start and end text.

panelFooter.zh-CN: 面板底部内容的 snippet，参数 index 为面板序号。
panelFooter.en-US: Snippet for the content below the panel; index is the panel's position.

panel.zh-CN: 仅范围模式：同时作为第 index 个面板的头部和底部，有内容时优先于 panelHeader 与 panelFooter。
panel.en-US: Range mode only: used as both the header and the footer of panel index, taking precedence over panelHeader and panelFooter while it has content.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom clear icon; effective when showClear is true.

focus.zh-CN: 使输入框获得焦点，同时打开面板；自定义触发器时无效。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input, which opens the panel; does nothing with a custom trigger.

blur.zh-CN: 移除输入框的焦点；自定义触发器时无效。
blur.en-US: Removes focus from the input; does nothing with a custom trigger.
